.. exception:: MultilineContinuationError

   Exception raised when a continuation line (a line beginning with
   whitespace) follows an option that has no value.  This condition is
   only possible when :attr:`!allow_no_value` is ``True``.  Subclass of
   :exc:`ParsingError`.

   Instances provide the following attributes:

   ``source``
      The name of the file or string source being parsed.

   ``lineno``
      The one-based line number of the offending continuation line.

   ``line``
      The exact content of the offending continuation line.
